QuestInfo.name: [Verne Mine] Halt! Spy!
QuestInfo.0: A little kid named #bUlrika#k wants to talk to you all of a sudden.
QuestInfo.1: #bUlrika#k says she will report you as a Black Wing Spy for talking with #rthe traitor, Wonny#k. If you listen to her request, she won't tell the Resistance. Hurry and find #bJun#k.
